abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

Charged Attack

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
_curatorNotes: N hits 1-3 are physical (no infusion). Charge is unavailable while in Pirouette or Lunar Prayer; in-stance N is the Sword Dance variant below.
N3 has ActionCharge=500 explicitly set in gcsim with TODO comment 'this action is illegal; need better way to handle it' — C key omitted on N3 per recipe.
C key omitted on N1/N2 because gcsim's InitNormalCancelSlice silent default = AnimationLength (24/27); recipe omits silent defaults.
Charged-attack chargeFrames covers 2 hits at chargeHitmarks=[26, 27]. Single chargeFrames map per recipe.
No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

abilities.name: Sword Dance
abilities.description: While Nilou is in the Pirouette state (after the initial Dance of Haftkarsvar cast) or the Lunar Prayer state (8s after a Sword Dance combo), her Normal Attacks become Sword Dance steps that are converted to Hydro DMG and treated as Elemental Skill DMG. Each press cycles through three steps: Sword Dance 1 (frame 14), Sword Dance 2 (frame 12), and the third step Luminous Illusion (frame 35).
_curatorNotes: gcsim categorisation: Sword Dance hits are AttackTagElementalArt with skill ICD (ICDTagElementalArt, ICDGroupDefault) — gcsim treats them as skill action damage. The schema's `abilityType: "normal"` here represents the input semantics (player presses N), not the underlying damage classification. ICD/scaling differences flagged for the planner to handle as-needed.

Frame data: swordDanceHitMarks=[14, 12, 35] with overrides ActionAttack=18 on SD1 and ActionAttack=55 on SD3. SD2 has no Attack override (default 23 = AnimationLength → omitted). C key omitted on all three because charge is disabled in Pirouette/Lunar Prayer (gcsim Attack() redirects to dance steps).

Each press advances gcsim's `skillStep` tag (0→1→2→0). The same counter is also advanced by Whirling Steps (in-stance E presses) — meaning a player can mix N and E to advance through the chain. The schema cannot represent the shared counter; flag for parser-side modeling.

Hydro infusion via `infusion: "hydro"`. Both Pirouette (10s) and Lunar Prayer (8s after SD3) are encoded as the same `inStance` condition since the planner only models a single stance state per character. SD3 ends Pirouette and starts Lunar Prayer; the parser cannot distinguish these two states currently.
C4 (Fricative Pulse): if SD3 (skillStep == 2) hits an enemy while Pirouette is active, +15 energy and +50% burst DMG for 8s. Authored on the C4 entry.

abilities.name: Dance of Haftkarsvar

durationModifiers.source: C1: Dance of the Waning Moon

abilities.description:
Enters the Pirouette state, dealing Hydro DMG to nearby opponents based on Nilou's Max HP.
While she is in the Pirouette state, Nilou's Normal Attacks and Elemental Skill will cause her to enter the Sword Dance and Whirling Steps stances respectively, causing DMG she deals to be converted to Hydro DMG that cannot be overridden and that is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

In these stances, Nilou's third dance step will end Pirouette, and has the following effects based on the type of said dance step:
·Sword Dance: unleashes a Luminous Illusion that deals Hydro DMG to opponents it touches and grants Nilou the Lunar Prayer effect. This effect converts Nilou's Normal Attacks into Sword Dance techniques, and her final hit will unleash a Luminous Illusion.
·Whirling Steps: Nilou unleashes a Whirling Water Wheel that deals AoE Hydro DMG and creates a Tranquility Aura that follows your active character around and applies Wet to opponents within its AoE.

Nilou is unable to perform Charged Attacks when under the effect of Pirouette or Lunar Prayer. These effects will be removed once she leaves the field.
abilities.caveat: The follower aura is shown from the first cast, but in game it appears only after the third Whirling Steps press; rotations ending sooner wrongly show it. In Lunar Prayer state, pressing E won't fire Whirling Steps in game, but the timeline allows it.
_curatorNotes: Skill cast frames: gcsim skillFrames = InitAbilSlice(22) with overrides ActionAttack=19, ActionSkill=19, ActionDash=17, ActionJump=17, ActionSwap=21. Initial hit at skillHitmark=16 (FlatDmg = skill[talent] × MaxHP). Cooldown 18s, no SetCDWithDelay (cooldownStartDelay = 0).

Stance duration 10s = Pirouette duration (gcsim AddStatus(pirouetteStatus, 10*60)). After the third dance step (SD3 or WS3) + 30/40 frame delay, Pirouette transitions to Lunar Prayer (after SD3) or Tranquility Aura (after WS3). The `inStance` condition on the in-stance N (Sword Dance) and in-stance E variants below is shared between Pirouette and Lunar Prayer for N, but only Pirouette enables E → Whirling Steps. See caveat.
ActionReady override (nilou.go): pressing E during Pirouette returns true regardless of base skill CD. The in-stance E (Whirling Steps) variants below have `cooldown: 0` and bypass the 18s base CD.

Tranquility Aura summon: spawnsAt=161 reflects the canonical "E E E E" timing — initial E (cancel into next at frame 19) → WS1 (cancel at +27) → WS2 (cancel at +32) → WS3 (hit at +43, aura spawns at +40 after that). Approximate; player input timing may shift this. mobility=follows: the aura follows the active character (gcsim TranquilityAura ticks on Player()). Hydro tick every 30 frames (0.5s) for the duration. Not terminated by swap (gcsim onExitField clears Pirouette and Lunar Prayer but not Tranquility Aura status).

Stance ends on SD3 / WS3 in-game; the schema's `behavior: "stance"` + `duration: 10` does not directly model 'ends on third step'. terminatesOnSwap=true reflects gcsim onExitField clearing Pirouette + Lunar Prayer on swap.

C1 extension (+6s) on Tranquility Aura is authored as a durationModifier on the summon. C1 also adds +65% Luminous Illusion DMG (SD3 multiplier) — flagged on the C1 entry, not on the base since it's variant-conditional.

Nilou is not implementable as a Tier B stance character without losing fidelity to the underlying state machine: shared step counter between SD and WS, two distinct end-states (Lunar Prayer vs Tranquility Aura), and the gating of E during Lunar Prayer. The current draft captures the dominant E E E E rotation cleanly and flags the rest.

[A7] The Tranquility Aura is authored on the base skill so the canonical E-E-E-E rotation (initial cast → WS1 → WS2 → WS3) displays correctly even though in-game it spawns only after WS3 — rationale already covered in existing notes. The dropped second short-rotation example was 'E E swap'. Lunar Prayer begins 8s after a Sword Dance combo.
anim 21 → 22 (2026-09-17, T1.5): gcsim skill.go skillFrames = InitAbilSlice(22); 21 is its swap override, and the frames audit could not see an `anim` until 2026-09-15.

abilities.name: Whirling Steps 1
abilities.description: First step of Whirling Steps — fires when E is pressed during Pirouette. Single Hydro hit at frame 21 (FlatDmg scaling on Max HP, multiplier whirlingSteps[0]).
_curatorNotes: Pattern 3 multi-stage skill chain (diluc-shape). All three Whirling Steps entries (WS1/WS2/WS3) share the same `input: ["E"]` and `conditions: { state: "inStance" }`. The planner's parser will resolve the first matching ability for each in-stance E press, which means in-game gcsim's `skillStep` advances WS1 → WS2 → WS3 but the planner currently picks WS1 each time. Frame data is captured for reviewer to wire chain-state in a future schema extension.
Frames: gcsim whirlingStepsFrames[0] = InitAbilSlice(33) with overrides ActionAttack=27, ActionSkill=27, ActionDash=26, ActionJump=27, ActionSwap=31. Hit at whirlingStepsHitMarks[0] = 21.
Cooldown 0: gcsim does not call SetCD inside WhirlingSteps. ActionReady override grants E availability during Pirouette regardless of base 18s skill CD.

Whirling Steps 1 (2026-09-17, T1.5): anim 31 → 33 (InitAbilSlice(33)). application at frame 21 with units 1 — gcsim whirlingStepsHitMarks = [21, 29, 43], Durability 25. All three steps carried WS1's frame 21 and no units. ⛔ The frames report's WS2/WS3 rows diff against WS1's slice (three abilities share one input + state, so one dump key) and are ORACLE ARTEFACTS — WS2 matches gcsim exactly. ⚠️ WS2/WS3 are unreachable from notation until sibling abilities can resolve past the first match.

abilities.name: Whirling Steps 2
abilities.description: Second step of Whirling Steps — second E press during Pirouette. Single Hydro hit at frame 29 (multiplier whirlingSteps[1]).
_curatorNotes: Frames: gcsim whirlingStepsFrames[1] = InitAbilSlice(62) with overrides ActionAttack=40, ActionSkill=32, ActionBurst=40, ActionDash=36, ActionJump=37. Hit at whirlingStepsHitMarks[1] = 29. Note swap=62 (no override) — the WS2 cancel slice keeps the InitAbilSlice default.
Same parser-broken caveat as WS1: this entry is not selected by the parser; WS1 wins for all in-stance E presses currently. Reviewer to add chain-state condition once schema supports it.

Whirling Steps 2 (2026-09-17, T1.5): application at frame 29 with units 1 — gcsim whirlingStepsHitMarks = [21, 29, 43], Durability 25. All three steps carried WS1's frame 21 and no units. ⛔ The frames report's WS2/WS3 rows diff against WS1's slice (three abilities share one input + state, so one dump key) and are ORACLE ARTEFACTS — WS2 matches gcsim exactly. ⚠️ WS2/WS3 are unreachable from notation until sibling abilities can resolve past the first match.

abilities.name: Water Wheel (Whirling Steps 3)
abilities.description: Third and final step of Whirling Steps — third E press during Pirouette. Unleashes the Water Wheel: AoE Hydro DMG at frame 43 (multiplier whirlingSteps[2]). After hit + 40 frames, Pirouette ends and the Tranquility Aura spawns (12s base, 18s with C1, follows the active character, applies Hydro Wet every 0.5s).
_curatorNotes: Frames: gcsim whirlingStepsFrames[2] = InitAbilSlice(63) with overrides ActionDash=57, ActionJump=57, ActionSwap=61. ActionAttack/Skill/Burst not overridden — those keys default to AnimationLength (63) and are omitted per recipe. Hit at whirlingStepsHitMarks[2] = 43.

Tranquility Aura DOES NOT spawn from this ability entry — it is authored on the base E (Dance of Haftkarsvar) so the simulation renders for the canonical "E E E E" rotation regardless of which WS variant the parser selects. See base E _curatorNotes for the timing rationale.
Same parser-broken caveat as WS1/WS2: this entry is not currently selected by the parser. Frame data captured for future wire-up.

C4 trigger: c4cb() in gcsim cons.go fires when SD3 (skillStep == 2) lands an enemy hit during Pirouette — that path is the SwordDance variant, not WhirlingSteps. So C4's energy + burst-damage buff is gated by Sword Dance N3, not WS3. Authored on C4 entry.

Whirling Steps 3 (2026-09-17, T1.5): anim 61 → 63 (InitAbilSlice(63)). application at frame 43 with units 1 — gcsim whirlingStepsHitMarks = [21, 29, 43], Durability 25. All three steps carried WS1's frame 21 and no units. ⛔ The frames report's WS2/WS3 rows diff against WS1's slice (three abilities share one input + state, so one dump key) and are ORACLE ARTEFACTS — WS2 matches gcsim exactly. ⚠️ WS2/WS3 are unreachable from notation until sibling abilities can resolve past the first match.

abilities.name: Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring
abilities.description:
Begins the dance of faraway dreams and springs that hear, causing a Lotus of Distant Waters to bloom, dealing AoE Hydro DMG based on Nilou's Max HP and applying the Lingering Aeon effect to all opponents hit.
After an interval, opponents affected by Lingering Aeon will take Hydro DMG.
_curatorNotes: Burst frames: gcsim burstFrames = InitAbilSlice(110) with overrides ActionAttack=108, ActionSkill=108, ActionJump=109, ActionSwap=107. ActionDash not overridden → omitted (default 110 = AnimationLength).

Initial hit at burstHitmark=91 (FlatDmg = burst[talent] × MaxHP). Each enemy hit receives a 121-frame status (lingeringAeonStatus); after expiry, a delayed Hydro DMG fires on that enemy (FlatDmg = burstAeon[talent] × MaxHP). The delayed hit is enemy-attached, similar to Mona's Bubble — not authored as a summon (caster-side); flagged for future schema work on enemy-attached debuffs.
Energy cost 70 matches gcsim EnergyMax. ConsumeEnergy(4) on cast is the standard energy-bar discount (the 4-energy refund pattern across Hydro chars).
C4 buff applies here when triggered: +50% burst DMG for 8s. Authored on C4 entry.

passives.name: Court of Dancing Petals
passives.description:
When all characters in the party are all Dendro or Hydro, and there are at least one Dendro character and one Hydro character:
The completion of the third dance step of Nilou's Dance of Haftkarsvar will grant all nearby characters the Golden Chalice's Bounty for 30s.
Characters under the effect of Golden Chalice's Bounty will increase the Elemental Mastery of all nearby characters by 100 for 10s whenever they are hit by Dendro attacks. Also, triggering the Bloom or Lunar-Bloom reaction will create Bountiful Cores instead of Dendro Cores.
Such Cores will burst very quickly after being created, and they have larger AoEs.
Bountiful Cores cannot trigger Hyperbloom or Burgeon, and they share an upper numerical limit with Dendro Cores. Bountiful Core DMG is considered DMG dealt by Dendro Cores produced by Bloom.
Should the party not meet the conditions for this Ascension Talent, any existing Golden Chalice's Bounty effects will be canceled.
passives.caveat: Shown as one 10s window per cast; in game the boost re-triggers whenever a party member is hit by a Dendro attack while Golden Chalice's Bounty (30s) is active, so in Bloom rotations it's nearly always up.
_curatorNotes: A1 has two effects: (a) Golden Chalice's Bounty status (30s) applied to all party members on SD3/WS3 hit, gated on a Hydro/Dendro-only team composition; (b) +100 EM team buff (10s) when Bountiful-buffed characters take Dendro damage. The Bountiful Cores transformation (Bloom → Bountiful) is the headline mechanic and stays notes-only (reaction schema frozen).

EM buff authored 2026-07-28 (capability sweep): gcsim nilou/asc.go:60-82 — OnPlayerHit by a Dendro attack while Golden Chalice's Bounty is active → AddStatMod EM=100 to every character for 10*60f, gated on c.onlyBloomTeam. Authored as onCast(skill) team em 100 (the Bounty arrives on the third dance step; the per-hit re-trigger has no primitive — see caveat).

Team gate encoded as all[ not(teamElementCount pyro/cryo/electro/anemo/geo >= 1), teamElementCount dendro >= 1 ]: teamElementCount excludes the holder, and Nilou herself supplies the required Hydro member, so no hydro clause is needed. Supersedes the old blocker note ('schema has no all-Hydro/Dendro condition') and the removed manual-trigger self-target stub from the genshin-db draft.
A4 contributes a scaling-buff component to Bountiful Core DMG that depends on Nilou's MaxHP above 30000 (capped at 400% bonus). Captured on the A4 entry below.

passives.name: Dreamy Dance of Aeons
passives.description:
Every 1,000 points of Nilou's Max HP above 30,000 will cause the DMG dealt by Bountiful Cores created by characters affected by Golden Chalice's Bounty to increase by 9%.
The maximum increase in Bountiful Core DMG that can be achieved this way is 400%.
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff on Bountiful Core damage: `bonus = (MaxHP - 30000) × 0.001 × 0.09`, capped at 4.0 (i.e., +400%). Per recipe — value field omitted on a manually-authored buff; reviewer to wire as BuffValue.scaling with stat `hp`, ratio 0.00009, cap 4 (or expressed as a percent: ratio 0.009, cap 400).
Updates every 30 frames (gcsim updateA4Bonus → 0.5s recompute cycle). The buff is on ReactBonusMod (not StatMod), so it stacks differently — flagged for parser handling.
Not authored as an effect; description-only entry.

constellations.name: Dance of the Waning Moon
constellations.description:
Dance of Haftkarsvar will be enhanced as follows:
·Luminous Illusion DMG is increased by 65%.
·The Tranquility Aura's duration is extended by 6s.
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (a) +65% Luminous Illusion (SD3) DMG — gcsim cons.go c1() adds DmgP=0.65 attack mod gated on `Abil == "Luminous Illusion"`. Not authored as an Effect — schema's `attribution` form for ability-specific damage bonuses needs review. (b) +6s Tranquility Aura duration — authored on the base E summon's durationModifiers.

constellations.name: The Starry Skies Their Flowers Rain
constellations.description:
After characters affected by the Golden Chalice's Bounty deal Hydro DMG to an opponent, that opponent's Hydro RES will be decreased by 35% for 10s. After dealing Bloom or Lunar-Bloom DMG to opponents, their Dendro RES will be decreased by 35% for 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Court of Dancing Petals."
_curatorNotes: Two resShred effects: hydro RES -35% on hydro-damage-by-A1-buffed-character, dendro RES -35% on bloom-reaction-damage. Both 10s duration, gated by Cons 2 + A1 active.

First effect's trigger should ideally gate on 'damage dealt by character with Golden Chalice's Bounty status' — the schema's `onHit` with `damageType: elemental` is approximate; reviewer to refine. Second effect uses `onReaction: bloom`. Lunar-Bloom (gcsim AttackTagDirectLunarBloom) not in the schema's reaction enum yet — only `bloom` listed.

constellations.name: Beguiling Shadowstep
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Fricative Pulse
constellations.description: After the third dance step of Dance of Haftkarsvar's Pirouette hits opponents, Nilou will gain 15 Elemental Energy, and DMG from her Dance of Abzendegi: Distant Dreams, Listening Spring will be increased by 50% for 8s.
_curatorNotes: Both effects fire on SD3 (Sword Dance step 2) hitting an enemy while Pirouette is active (gcsim c4cb gates on `skillStep == 2 && pirouetteStatus`). Not WS3 — only SD3. Inherited `manual` trigger; reviewer to refine to `onHit` with `abilityType: "normal"` + `state: "inStance"` once that combination is supported.
+15 energy is a one-shot grant on trigger, not a periodic buff. The schema's `energy` effect type should fit; value: 15.
+50% burst DMG for 8s — authored on `burstDmgBonus` stat. The original draft had a `manual` trigger that was already in the file; schema's per-character `burstDmgBonus` is the right stat key.

constellations.name: Twirling Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Dance of Haftkarsvar by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Frostbreaker's Melody
constellations.description:
For every 1,000 points of Max HP, Nilou's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 0.6% and 1.2% respectively.
The maximum increase in CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG via this method is 30% and 60% respectively.
_curatorNotes: Always-on HP-scaling self-buff on CR/CD. ratio = MaxHP × 0.0006 / MaxHP × 0.0012 (per-1000-HP form expressed as per-HP ratios). Caps at 30% / 60% respectively (i.e., 50000 MaxHP for max benefit).

gcsim recomputes every 60 frames (1s) via QueueCharTask(c.c6, 60). The schema's scaling buff is recomputed continuously by the planner at render time; the 60-frame cadence is a sim implementation detail.

Original draft had four separate manual-trigger buffs (two with values 0.6/0.6 representing the per-1000-HP rate, two with values 30/30 representing the cap). Consolidated to two scaling buffs with cap fields per recipe.
